# Path of Flames

- **Status:** 🔶 Partial
- **Skills affected:** Path of Flames
- **Mechanic tags:** dot, damage-pool, channeled, methodology
- **Last verified:** 2026-07-10 by Tyra

## Setup

SS12. Skill level 16, no gear unless stated. Target: the standard Level-85 dummy (30% erosion resistance, 30% elemental resistance, 50% armor) — see [training-dummy](training-dummy.md). Path of Flames is `Spell / Fire / Channeled / Persistent / Area`, base 299/sec Fire damage at L16 (299 × 0.70 elemental resistance = 209.3, Tyra-confirmed against the L16 sheet reading 209), cast speed 0.333, no hit component. "Meter" = the in-game damage-recount readout (span average, not the tooltip).

## Raw data points

See [dot-model](dot-model.md) for the full twelve-parse sweep this skill contributes half of (baseline, +9%/+27% increased, Control Spell, Control Spell + 18% increased). Baseline L16: model 209.3 DPS vs meter 210.0 (−0.3% model error) — the tightest match in the whole dataset.

## Derived / confirmed formula

`dot_dps = 299/sec × (1 + Σ increased) × Π(1 + additional) × resist_only_mult`, resistance-only mitigation (armor excluded — see [dot-armor-exclusion](dot-armor-exclusion.md)) and no crit ([dot-no-crit](dot-no-crit.md)).

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Status `partial`, not `confirmed`: inherits the dot-model.json residual — see that entry's `notes`. Unlike Mind Control, Path of Flames shows no 31-tick character-sheet offset in the raw data (7.0/tick, sheet reads 209, meter reads 210 — neither is a clean ×29/×31 rung off 210); the divisor quirk documented in dot-model.json appears skill-specific, not universal, and is deliberately not modeled either way.

## Implementation (engine model)

`backend/engine/skill_resolver.py::_resolve_path_of_flames` (~L649) registers the skill via the shared `_resolve_dot_skill` (~L594, `base_text_key="Descript"`, `damage_type="fire"`) — notably different from Mind Control: Path of Flames' `progression[*].values.damage` field is empty/None at every level, so the per-level base ("Fire Path: Deals 299 Persistent Fire Damage every second.") had to be parsed from `values.Descript` instead. Same shared config otherwise: `hit_forms_by_level={}`, `is_spell=True`, `ChanneledSpec(max_stacks=5, behavior="refresh", max_from_data=False)` — `max_from_data=False` because Path of Flames' SS12 text omits the explicit "Channels up to 5 stacks" line Mind Control has (the 5-stack cap is a fallback, matching the Icebound Beam precedent). Damage computed by `backend/engine/offense.py::compute_dot` (~L1101) — see [dot-model](dot-model.md)'s implementation note for the shared mechanics. Covered by `backend/tests/test_dot.py` and the auto-captured golden fixture `backend/tests/fixtures/support_skill_golden/path_of_flames.json`.
